calls.title: Jason <> Karen publishing process, guidelines
calls.summary: The team focused on redirecting SEO efforts primarily towards enhancing core website and blog content, proposing a structured content calendar and thematic pillars for coherence. Key discussions included refreshing the keyword strategy to align with market changes, defining three main content themes (experimentation, AI, and feature flags) for brand differentiation, and prioritizing the refresh of existing blogs over generating new content. Acknowledging that traditional SEO metrics are insufficient, the team agreed to adopt a broader framework that emphasizes traffic quality and engagement while incorporating competitive analysis tools for content planning. Participants discussed improving collaboration and processes, emphasizing the importance of clear roles and responsibilities to manage workloads effectively and enable better SEO outcomes.
calls.keywords: SEO strategy, Content calendar, Keyword research, Analytics reporting, Feature flags, Podcast content
